now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
now.text: Melinda May takes up the Berserker Staff when its rage overwhelms Grant Ward, and she uses its strength to defeat Petra Larsen and the last of the pagan cult.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who takes up the Berserker Staff and defeats them.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Pagan cultists she defeats with the Berserker Staff's strength.

changes.evidence: In The Well (Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#8) Ward fights and defeats Jakob Nystrom at the Irish church; May only takes the staff from Ward afterward and defeats Petra Larsen and another Paganist. Nystrom and May never deal with each other: it is a shared battle with two separate actions, and the stage text itself is about Petra, not Nystrom. Nothing on screen implies they know each other.
